title: 9 High-Paying Jobs, No Degree Required [VIDEO]
summary: Think you need a degree to earn a great salary? Think again! This video explores 9 in-demand jobs that pay well WITHOUT necessarily requiring a four-year degree.
body_markdown:
Do you need a degree to land a high-paying job? The answer might surprise you—no, you don’t!


Discover nine exciting and rewarding careers that pay well without requiring a bachelor’s degree, including pilot, web developer, and elevator repairer. From soaring through the skies to creating stunning websites, these jobs open doors to new opportunities without the traditional academic route.
